8wfk:
Master of Science - Computer Science and Engineering offers students a comprehensive grasp of cutting-edge industry subjects while equipping them to engage in fundamental and applied research in computer science. The program encompasses various tracks, including artificial intelligence and machine learning, systems, and a research track that enables students to pursue personalized projects or engage in supervised research.

The Master of Science in Computer Science and Engineering program offers three tracks to choose from:

  • Research
  • Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning
  • Software/Hardware Systems

All applications are to be submitted under the Master of Science in Computer Science and Engineering programme only. Once the university receives and reviews each application, the appropriate specialization or track is offered to the applicant accordingly.
